fusions.name: Spooking Shot
fusions.desc: Fires a loud shot at an enemy up to 9 tiles away that deals 8 piercing damage and stuns it for 0.5 seconds. You hold 3 shots, and kills give them back.

fusions.name: Buckshot
fusions.desc: Looses 5 pellets at once in a spread out to 7 tiles, each dealing 6 piercing damage. Every pellet is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Far Sense
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Return Fire
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, a shot cracks out to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles and deals 5 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
